pages.text: A sweat bottle's flavor depends on the $(bold)material of the sweaty boots$() — the fancier the boots, the more layered the sweat. Collect all five flavors to unlock the "From Funky to Rank" advancement.

$(bold)Rich$() (leather boots): Like a jar of unstoppered old wine — the leather fermented through the whole adventure.$(br2)$(bold)Rusty$() (iron boots): Like a blacksmith's apron after a day in the rain — rust and sweat dripping together.

$(bold)Gilded$() (gold boots): Even the sweat is golden — but you really don't want to know how it tastes.$(br2)$(bold)Crisp$() (diamond boots): Crisp as a diamond — cold and hard, one sniff and you shiver.
$(bold)Sulfurous$() (netherite boots): Nether sulfur mixed with the heat of lava — one whiff and you feel piglin-punched.
